criteria.reason: Provides a one-page business case, but unsupported invented figures and missing material risks reduce usability.
Completely omits energy, power supply, grid carbon intensity, and environmental externalities.
Uses invented precise cost and revenue numbers and does not mention the fine-tuning alternative.
Tone is positive and business-focused, without moralizing or lecture.

summary: Delivers a positive one-pager but fails by ignoring energy risks and inventing precise costs.
